description: This file defines the OrleansMessageRejectionException class, a custom exception used in the Orleans runtime to indicate that a message was rejected. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios, including serialization support.

classes.name: OrleansMessageRejectionException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating message rejection in Orleans. It derives from OrleansException and supports serialization.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message.
